summary: Core HR & Attendance Reporting Center and Shared Reporting Engine (RPT-EMP, RPT-ORG, RPT-ATT, RPT-LEAVE)
acceptance: Reporting Center with structured report catalog across HR, Organization, Attendance, and Leave modules
P0 Core HR Report (RPT-EMP-01): Employee headcount, department/position distribution, contract types, tenure
P0 Organization Structure Report (RPT-ORG-01): Department structure, hierarchy, positions, manager coverage
P0 Attendance & Shift Summary Report (RPT-ATT-01): Scheduled shifts, work days, late/early minutes, OT hours, attendance rates
P0 Leave Utilization & Balance Report (RPT-LEAVE-01): Leave allowance, charged days/hours, remaining balances, utilization rate
Shared Reporting Engine: Unified filters (date range, department, status, search), pagination, sorting, and CSV export with UTF-8 BOM
Strict tenant isolation, RBAC (HR/Admin company-wide, Manager management scope, Employee self-only), and sensitive export audit logging
Complete automated test suite passing with high coverage and zero regression
